args.reason: The user reports an order API 200 but no downstream callback. First I need the current order lifecycle state to determine whether the callback is even due yet, since HTTP 200 on order GET does not prove completion.

The order GET shows HTTP 200 and status COMPLETED, but that alone does not prove callback delivery. I need the bound callback event's current transport acknowledgement or failure before deciding whether the missing callback is due, delayed, failed, or acknowledged.

model_traces.assistant_text: I have the order status (COMPLETED) and the callback delivery facts (ACKNOWLEDGED, receiver HTTP 202). What's still unknown is whether the receiver actually finished processing the event — an ACK/202 is not completed processing.

args.reason: Delivery is ACKNOWLEDGED with receiver HTTP 202, but the user reports downstream did not get/complete the callback; need the receiver's actual processing state to distinguish transport acknowledgement from completed processing.
